title: MIND PRISON 2.0 UPDATE COMING SOON
author: Impetigocheez
selftext:
I released Mind Prison: The Last War in May 2026, when I was still getting into game development. It was the first game I ever managed to put on Steam. The version that’s up now is pretty basic, but the idea behind it stuck with me, and I wanted to see what I could do with it now that I know a lot more about making games.

A lot of the inspiration came from Marathon, especially its lore about rogue AI. I kept thinking, what if you made a strategy game where you’re the AI war machine that’s gone loose? That’s the premise I built Mind Prison around.

For 2.0, I’m taking the original terminal-based game and rebuilding it as a fully 3D strategy game. I’ve put a ton of time into getting it closer to the game I pictured when I started, and at this point it feels like a whole new game. I’m aiming for late winter 2027. The update will be free for everyone who owns the game, and the base price will stay the same. After 2.0, I plan to keep adding units and giving players more to do.

I used AI during development, and a big part of this rebuild has been learning the tools that let me make more of the game myself. I’m even painting the new cover art by hand. It’s been cool to see how much more of the original vision I can actually pull off now.

Anyway, here’s the trailer. I’m excited to finally show what I’ve been working on, and I’d love to hear what you think.
